sections.title: Before booking in Regina
sections.html:
Request an example of the result format and ask whether it includes practical combinations. If you have a previous analysis, bring it and explain what you found useful or confusing. Do not expect every system to use identical names or boundaries. A meaningful second opinion should explain differences, not simply provide another label.

  • How are the different methods combined in my consultation?
  • What practical combinations and materials will I take away?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Try applying the advice to one choice at a time. Compare two tops with the same trousers, or two lip families with your usual makeup. The app can support that exploration on your phone, while a studio session can provide live discussion of physical colours. Choose based on the kind of feedback you need and the clarity of the deliverables.
